name: Completed Objects Without Compensation
query:
SELECT
    ps.name AS "Project ID:Link/Project Setup:120",
    ps.project_name AS "Project Name::200",
    ps.work_team AS "Work Team:Link/Work Team:120",
    ps.team_leader AS "Team Leader:Link/User:120",
    ps.status AS "Status::100",
    ps.completion_date AS "Completion Date:Date:100",
    CONCAT(MONTHNAME(ps.completion_date), ' ', YEAR(ps.completion_date)) AS "Completion Month::120"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
WHERE
    ps.status = 'Completed'
    AND ps.name NOT IN (
        SELECT
            col.object
        FROM
            `tabCompleted Objects List` col
        INNER JOIN
            `tabTotal Compensation` tc
        ON
            col.parent = tc.name
        WHERE
            tc.docstatus = 1
    )
    /* Filters */
    AND (%(completion_month)s IS NULL OR CONCAT(MONTHNAME(ps.completion_date), ' ', YEAR(ps.completion_date)) = %(completion_month)s)
    AND (%(work_team)s IS NULL OR ps.work_team = %(work_team)s)
    AND (%(team_leader)s IS NULL OR ps.team_leader = %(team_leader)s)
    AND (%(project_name)s IS NULL OR ps.project_name = %(project_name)s)
ORDER BY
    ps.completion_date DESC;
